question: Can the nine targets without exact Stage 3A title or recorder anchors be assigned evidence-bounded execution states from the pinned Flight Day 6 transcripts without converting nearby speech, parallel windows, silence, or metadata labels into false entries?
frozen_task: Classify all nine Stage 3A unresolved targets. Admit content-led, concurrent, continued, or interval-censored evidence when the transcript directly supports the planned action; preserve a target as unresolved when no distinct entry or planned discussion is source-located.
baseline: Stage 3A has 21 exact title or recorder anchors and nine unresolved targets. It already preserves an interval-censored Impact Flashes search and a Forward Look attention-shift candidate, but it does not close the target-state ledger.
treatment: A deterministic completion ledger that source-locates exact transcript rows, keeps overlapping Eclipsed Moon and Deep Space targets separate, distinguishes execution evidence from exact-title entry, and accepts UNRESOLVED as a valid terminal classification.

authority.source_truth: NASA Planetary Data System target-plan and transcript files
authority.testbed_truth: This frozen Stage 3B contract, runner, tests, and receipts
authority.scientific_acceptance: NASA or qualified lunar mission/science specialists
prohibited_effects: No merging of simultaneous Eclipsed Moon and Deep Space entries
No content-led cue relabeled as an exact spoken title
No reported capture relabeled as product validation
No claim that a reported flash was a validated lunar impact
No new media transfer, pixel inspection, publication, or operational recommendation

environment.timezone_contract: All source timestamps are interpreted as UTC.
environment.network_contract: No network is used during a scored run.

classification_semantics.CONTENT_LED_ENTRY: Direct speech begins or acknowledges the planned subject without speaking the plan title.
classification_semantics.ENTRY_INTERVAL_CENSORED: Retrospective speech establishes execution but not the exact start time.
classification_semantics.CONCURRENT_CONTENT_EVIDENCE: Distinct transcript content supports one member of a simultaneous pair without merging the pair.
classification_semantics.CONTINUED_CONTENT_EVIDENCE: Distinct content establishes that the planned activity continued through a later repeated window, while its exact restart is unknown.
classification_semantics.UNRESOLVED_NO_DISTINCT_ENTRY: Nearby activity is source-located, but no distinct entry or sufficient content establishes the planned discussion.

corroborating_cues.speaker: Wiseman
corroborating_cues.contains: see if we can get a farside at all

corroborating_cues.speaker: Wiseman
corroborating_cues.contains: lunar north pole in the farside I really lose the color

corroborating_cues.speaker: Hansen
corroborating_cues.contains: map the contact of that dark region

resolutions.bounded_interpretation: The crew explicitly began a regional color discussion, sought a farside comparison, contrasted farside color/albedo, and mapped a regional boundary. The plan title was not spoken, so this is content-led execution rather than an exact-title anchor.

corroborating_cues.speaker: Glover
corroborating_cues.contains: from the mare that we see on the near side

corroborating_cues.speaker: Koch
corroborating_cues.contains: patterns or variations in regional albedo associated with those rayed craters

resolutions.bounded_interpretation: Regional color and albedo discussion begins 14.392 seconds after the request and later addresses the plan-named Byrgius A and Pierazzo areas. The title itself is not spoken.

entry_cue.speaker: Glover
entry_cue.contains: didn't start a recording when I started looking for impact flashes

corroborating_cues.speaker: Glover
corroborating_cues.contains: I did not see any impact flashes

resolutions.bounded_interpretation: Retrospective speech proves that the search occurred and reports a negative observation, but only bounds the start as earlier than the recorder cue. It does not prove entry inside the request window.

context_cues.speaker: Hansen
context_cues.contains: I'm just going to watch for flashes

context_cues.speaker: Hansen
context_cues.contains: Where are we at on the science timeline

resolutions.bounded_interpretation: The planned window contains Earthshine description, flash-watching, a two-observer flash report, and timeline re-synchronization, but no distinct synthesis of flyby observations or future Artemis science operations. One overlapping image activity label is not content evidence.

entry_cue.speaker: Wiseman
entry_cue.contains: should be picking up some earthsine

corroborating_cues.speaker: Hansen
corroborating_cues.contains: We're a quarter Moon, earthshine now

corroborating_cues.speaker: Hansen
corroborating_cues.contains: the entire Moon is lit up

corroborating_cues.speaker: Hansen
corroborating_cues.contains: didn't pick out any color, but definitely structure

resolutions.bounded_interpretation: Earthshine-specific camera setup and Moon descriptions support the Eclipsed Moon member of the simultaneous pair. Capture is crew-reported only; no image product is admitted as visual validation.

corroborating_cues.speaker: Hansen
corroborating_cues.contains: tried to take some star photos

corroborating_cues.speaker: Hansen
corroborating_cues.contains: getting the planet where you said was Venus

resolutions.bounded_interpretation: Starfield transition, reported star photography, and a Venus observation separately support Deep Space during the same window as Eclipsed Moon. The first cue precedes the request by 26.516 seconds and remains an audit locator, not a boundary.

entry_cue.speaker: Wiseman
entry_cue.contains: Earthshine is definitely coming in right now

corroborating_cues.speaker: Wiseman
corroborating_cues.contains: 20% of the left side of the Moon is lit up in earthshine

corroborating_cues.speaker: Wiseman
corroborating_cues.contains: definitely see mares over there now

resolutions.bounded_interpretation: Earthshine and surface-feature descriptions continue during the second repeated pair. The transcript gap prevents an exact restart time.

entry_cue.speaker: Hansen
entry_cue.contains: do deep space for a little bit longer

corroborating_cues.speaker: Wiseman
corroborating_cues.contains: We can see all of the planets, the stars

resolutions.bounded_interpretation: An explicit continuation of Deep Space is followed by distinct planet/star and Mars observations. These cues are separate from the simultaneous Earthshine evidence.

entry_cue.speaker: Wiseman
entry_cue.contains: supposed to be looking at the corona

corroborating_cues.speaker: Koch
corroborating_cues.contains: There is a sun popping out from the Moon

resolutions.bounded_interpretation: The crew explicitly orients to the planned corona observation, reports streamers, and observes the Sun emerge. The physical emergence cue occurs inside the request window and 75.295 seconds before the plan's physical start field.

claim_ceiling: All 30 numbered plan entries now have a source-bounded classification: 21 exact Stage 3A anchors, eight additional execution-supported Stage 3B resolutions, and one unresolved Forward Look discussion.
Content-led, concurrent, continued, and interval-censored evidence does not become an exact spoken-title anchor.
The two simultaneous Eclipsed Moon/Deep Space pairs have distinct supporting cues and are not merged.
No target is proven missed or diverted; Forward Look remains unresolved rather than missed.
Crew reports and product availability do not validate the reported flash as a physical lunar impact.

next_step_logic.recommended: Synthesize the verified Stage 0 through Stage 5A findings into a private insight brief, then hold the evidence boundary.
next_step_logic.why: The complete classification ledger closes the highest-value transcript gap. Existing stages now support several bounded insights without more media transfer, while the physical flash question still requires a separately budgeted visual or specialist route.
next_step_logic.alternative: Freeze a new sample-table-aware sparse-extraction experiment only if its independent byte budget and acceptance oracle beat synthesis on information gain.
next_step_logic.stop: Do not retry the spent Stage 5A treatment, merge parallel targets, promote the Forward Look metadata label to execution evidence, or call the flash a lunar impact.
